var baseEquipId = 3640;
let currentEquip = null;
var equips = origin.equips().filter((equip) => !!equip &&DataManager.isArmor(equip) && equip.baseItemId === baseEquipId);
if(equips.length > 0)
   currentEquip = equips[0];
var mw = !!currentEquip ?  origin.getEquipItemObject(currentEquip) : null;
var level = !!mw ? mw.level() : 0;


target._stackingPoison = target._stackingPoison || 1;
var stacks = target._stackingPoison
var damage1 = origin.atk;
var damage2 = origin.mat;
var damage3 = origin.level;
var damage = stacks * (damage1 + damage2) * damage3 *(1+level);
target.startAnimation(130);
target.gainHp(-damage);
target.startDamagePopup();
target.clearResult();
if (target.isDead()) {
  target.performCollapse();
}
</Custom Regenerate Effect>
